description: Flag fifo_full asserts high early when item_count only reaches 7 (FIFO_DEPTH - 1), rejecting the 8th push operation and leaving item_count stuck at 7 instead of 8.
When FIFO is filled with 8 elements, wr_ptr wraps around and equals rd_ptr, incorrectly asserting fifo_empty high even though the queue is full (item_count == 8).
After 2 cycles in S_MAIN_YELLOW, state_debug transitions directly to S_SIDE_YELLOW (3) instead of S_SIDE_GREEN (2), completely skipping the side road green phase.

When car_present remains 1, FSM gets stuck in S_SIDE_GREEN (2) after 6 cycles without transitioning to S_SIDE_YELLOW (3); additionally, if car_present drops to 0 before cycle 6, FSM fails to terminate early.
When car_present == 1, FSM immediately transitions from S_MAIN_GREEN (0) to S_MAIN_YELLOW (1) on the very first clock edge instead of waiting for the full 6 TICKS_GREEN cycles.
alternative_fixes: if (car_present && (timer_cnt == TICKS_GREEN - 1'b1)) in the first branch.

description: After releasing reset (reset_n = 1) and setting cnt_en = 1, val_out remains pinned at 0 at every rising edge of clock clk.
When reset_n = 1, FSM is forced into S_MAIN_GREEN (0) and timer_cnt = 0 at every clock edge, failing to transition to S_MAIN_YELLOW (1) even after 6 cycles with car_present = 1.
When FIFO is full (wr_ptr == rd_ptr) and simultaneous read/write occurs (push_req = 1, pop_req = 1), data_out reads newly written data_in (0xEE) instead of the oldest element at rd_ptr (0xB2).
Non-overflow addition (0x15 + 0x23 = 0x38) works correctly, but 8-bit overflow addition (0xFF + 0x01) leaves flag_carry consistently 0 instead of 1.
When writing more than 4 elements into FIFO, elements 5..8 overwrite mem[0..3], causing first pop operation to return 0x14 (20) instead of 0x10 (16).
When transitioning from S_MAIN_YELLOW to S_SIDE_GREEN, timer_cnt is not cleared to 0 but retains 1, shortening the side green phase by 1 cycle (lasts only 5 cycles instead of 6 when car_present = 1).
When operation result is non-zero but has lower 4 bits equal to 0 (e.g. 0x50 - 0x20 = 0x30), flag_zero erroneously asserts to 1.
When an invalid opcode is provided (op_code = 3'b101), alu_res does not reset to 0 but latches the previous value (0x5A) from the preceding XOR operation.
alternative_fixes: Default initialization alu_res = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}}; flag_carry = 1'b0; at the top of always @(*) block before the case statement.

description: When performing a single pop (pop_req = 1, push_req = 0), data_out is read correctly but item_count does not decrement to 0, remaining at 1 and preventing fifo_empty from asserting.
When count enable is disabled (cnt_en = 0) and reset_n = 1, counter does not hold current value but continues incrementing on each clock rising edge.

if (!reset_n) begin

description: When counting reaches limit_val (4), term_reached flag asserts, but on next clock edge val_out increments to 5 instead of wrapping to 0 (wrapping only on the subsequent cycle).
State S_MAIN_YELLOW persists for 3 cycles (timer_cnt = 0, 1, 2) instead of 2 cycles, leaving state_debug equal to 1 (S_MAIN_YELLOW) at clock edge 8 instead of transitioning to 2 (S_SIDE_GREEN).
Subtractions with distinct operands (A > B and A < B) are correct, but subtracting equal numbers (0x4A - 0x4A) erroneously sets flag_carry to 1 instead of 0.
